Title: Name changes: SQL Advanced Threat Protection

Body.Content:
SQL Advanced Threat Protection is a new security package for Azure SQL Database. It provides a single location for advanced SQL capabilities, including threat detection, SQL vulnerability assessment (generally available), and information protection (preview). Learn more.

Effective August 1, 2018, names will change for two SQL Threat Detection services. See the following table for name change details.
